insider_note: The one of the three transfers that needs NO contact and NO virus. Say that and the definition is done.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What transformation is
steps.margin_note: Definition plus the two things it does NOT need.
lines: TRANSFORMATION is the uptake of NAKED DNA
fragments by a bacterium directly from its
No contact with another cell and no virus is
steps.why: Free DNA lying in the surroundings can be absorbed by a competent cell, which is why this is the only transfer that needs no second living partner.
common_mistakes: Saying transformation needs a pilus. That is CONJUGATION.
Saying the DNA comes from a virus. That is TRANSDUCTION.
steps.memory_tip: Loose DNA picked up from outside: nothing else involved.

steps.label: Who and where
steps.margin_note: Name, organism, and the link forward to the DNA chapter.
lines: It was discovered by FREDERICK GRIFFITH in
PNEUMONIAE, the bacterium that causes pneumonia.
His experiment showed that a TRANSFORMING
PRINCIPLE passed from the dead S bacteria into
the live R bacteria. Avery, MacLeod and
McCarty later showed that this principle is DNA.
steps.why: Griffith's transformation experiment is the starting point of the whole molecular biology chapter, which is why the same name appears there too.
common_mistakes: Naming Lederberg. Lederberg discovered CONJUGATION and TRANSDUCTION.
Naming E. coli. Griffith worked on Streptococcus pneumoniae.
